name: moth
description: One-call project audit, Guidance activation, and controller orchestration

interface.shortDescription: One call for project truth, Mio, and architecture control.
interface.longDescription: Moth inspects repository evidence, activates registered Guidance such as Mio and architect-controller in order, separates executor self-attestation from host verification, and drives work through project-owned gates.
defaultPrompt: Use $moth to understand this project and complete the requested change.
Use $moth to audit this repository and verify the evidence gates.
Use $moth to plan and execute this architecture change.
